scientific_integrity: The Gaussian conditioning identity, binomial rank law, beta order-statistic reduction, and numerical benchmarks were independently replayed from the embedded standard-library verifier; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-sample formula is for a one-sided Gaussian model-X CRT with one predictor and the marginal-covariance statistic.
The explicit \(1/B\) expansion is stated on exact-size reciprocal-level subsequences \(\alpha=1/q\), \(B=q\ell-1\).
Originality retains residual risk from older generic Monte Carlo randomization-test literature under different terminology.
title: Exact finite-resample power and first-order resampling tax of the Gaussian CRT
